以下是基于九宫格分镜图的连续视频提示词（Prompt），已精简描述以符合要求：

**Shot 1 (左上)**:Close-up of sleek black vacuum floor head. A bright blue LED light strip illuminates. Dark background, cinematic product shot.

**Shot 2 (中上)**:X-ray view of a metallic vacuum tube. Glowing blue airflow energy pulses rapidly through the center, demonstrating suction power.

**Shot 3 (右上)**:Close-up of the filter unit. Vertical blue UV lights activate inside the dark, high-tech casing.

**Shot 4 (左中)**:Exploded 3D view of the roller brush assembly. Hairs and debris are sucked away. Internal motor glows blue.

**Shot 5 (正中)**:Internal mechanical view of the floor head. Dual gears and motor components rotating seamlessly. Industrial tech style.

**Shot 6 (右中)**:Low-angle macro shot of the vacuum wheels. The inner wheel hubs glow with a blue ring as they roll forward smoothly.

**Shot 7 (左下)**:Close-up of a mini motorized brush attachment hovering. Focus on the bristle textures and sleek black design.

**Shot 8 (中下)**:Transparent view of the vacuum joint connector. Glowing blue airflow bends dynamically through the angled tube.

**Shot 9 (右下)**:Macro shot of the handle's digital display screen. A high-tech blue UI interface lights up, showing performance data.

**Camera & Style Notes (Global)**:Photorealistic, 3D render style, macro product cinematography, dark background, neon blue accent lighting, smooth fluid camera movements.

镜头8 (14-15s): 特写跟随。洗地机滚刷严丝合缝地紧贴木质踢脚线滑过，展现双贴边设计，无死角清洁。

镜头9 (15-17s): 特写推进。机身顶部黑色玻璃面板上的LED屏幕亮起，数字跳动，充满智能科技感。

镜头10 (17-20s): 全景俯拍。洗地机在宽敞的客厅中推行，划过一道优美的轨迹，地面光洁如镜，倒影清晰。

镜头11 (20-22s): 中景固定。银灰色洗地机被稳稳放回黑色基站，机身与底座严丝合缝，橙色细节光点亮。

镜头12 (22-24s): 微距平移。基站底部滚刷处，微微升起热气流造成的空气扭曲，暗示热风自烘干，画面温暖。

镜头13 (24-26s): 低角度后撤。一尘不染的微反光地面，倒映着窗外明亮的自然光与室内极简装饰。

镜头14 (26-28s): 中景上摇。静置在基站上的米家洗地机，金属机身在阳光下闪烁微光，宛如艺术品。

镜头15 (28-30s): 广角固定。极简高端室内，阳光斜射，洗地机静立于右侧，窗外远山湖水，画面唯美宁静，电影级质感。
